components.role: Existing NGA public pages, guardian form, waiver/invoice/receipt adapters and offline verification fixtures; an integration reference, not a new-event activation script
Reusable game engines plus the current server-only capacity/publication ledger integration; historical ready=true activation is deliberately excluded

notes: The native API allowlist contains only the six MVF month/division keys. Add new keys and isolated capacity through a reviewed change before using native registration for another event.
Snapshots may contain historical enabled application flags. They are source evidence, never an instruction to enable a copied event.
No credentials, real registrants, participant photos, invoices, provider exports or live evidence files belong in a reusable template.
